race.description: Wild River Concrete Dalby Cup Hcp
race.comment: THE DEPUTY (5) was just out of the money when resuming from a spell last start over 1300m at Toowoomba, beaten 1.75 lengths. Strip fitter and capable of running a bold race. Only needs some luck navigating from the sticky draw to be featuring. DON PEDRO (3) improved sharply last time out to score by 0.7 lengths over 1400m at Moree a week ago. Finds a suitable race and can build on that solid recent effort. LAST CHANCE SALOON (7) is resuming today but will be fitter for a recent trial. Rates a place chance from the inside marble. SIR CARTER (4) has been in the market but missed the frame at his last two starts, the latest when fifth over 1200m at Murwillumbah. Look for an improved run here.
